npcs.name: Tovin Brassbarrow
npcs.description: The general store owner people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: Tovin Brassbarrow works from a general store with the stubborn patience of a 121-year-old Dwarf who has already survived harder seasons. He taps the ledger thrice before he trusts a total, and keeps the brass abacus older than the shop sign close when tempers rise. Father to Lina; debtor to Marrow. His private aim is simple: hand a debt-free shop to Lina. Still, he flinches at the thought of losing the store to Marrow's interest rates. Lately a fresh problem has landed in his lap: A crate labeled nails arrived full of locked strongbox parts.
npcs.personality: Soft-spoken until principles are poked; taps the ledger thrice before he trusts a total.
npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to hand a debt-free shop to Lina.
npcs.secret: Night thoughts keep returning to losing the store to Marrow's interest rates, especially since: A crate labeled nails arrived full of locked strongbox parts.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near a general store on a night Tovin worked late.
npcs.voice: Quick local diction, then sudden silences that mean more than words.
npcs.appearance: Easy to spot near a general store: dwarf, practical layers, and the brass abacus older than the shop sign.

relationships.note: Owes Marrow for a ruined shipment loan.

npcs.name: Lina Brassbarrow
npcs.description: A shop clerk rooted at the general store counter, known for how she corrects prices under her breath in Dwarvish.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable shop clerk are often sent to Lina, who claims the general store counter as familiar ground. At 98, this Dwarf has learned to watch hands before faces. She corrects prices under her breath in Dwarvish; neighbors joke that she would miss a festival before misplacing the ink-stained apron with secret pockets for disputed notes. Tovin's daughter and clerk. She is saving courage and coin alike to modernize inventory before the harvest fair, while trying not to let her father making another handshake loan decide the ending. Matched a pawn ticket description to a ring Lysa Thorne tried to sell quietly.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; corrects prices under her breath in Dwarvish.
npcs.motivation: To modernize inventory before the the harvest fair, even while fearing her father making another handshake loan.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than she admits: Matched a pawn ticket description to a ring Lysa Thorne tried to sell quietly.
npcs.rumor: Locals whisper that the ink-stained apron with secret pockets for disputed notes once belonged to a traveler who vanished on the road.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A dwarf silhouette framed by the general store counter, hands seldom empty of the ink-stained apron with secret pockets for disputed notes.

npcs.description: A moneylender rooted at a cramped credit office, known for how he smiles with his mouth and not his eyes.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable moneylender are often sent to Marrow, who claims a cramped credit office as familiar ground. At 46, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. He smiles with his mouth and not his eyes; neighbors joke that he would miss a festival before misplacing the velvet pouch of signed markers. Creditor to Tovin and Cal; employs Bask. He is saving courage and coin alike to own a seat on the town local officials through 'gifts', while trying not to let the watch linking him to Bask's broken fingers decide the ending. Keeps a second book of debts the mayor would not want read aloud.

npcs.name: Hedda Loom
npcs.description: Hedda holds down a clothier's shop with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Some locals swear Hedda was born mid-shift at a clothier's shop; the truth is only slightly less devoted. This human clothier, now 39, treats competence like courtesy. She pins patterns while reading faces, never far from the mannequin wearing last season's scandalous sleeve. Client relationship with Lysa Thorne. Ask what she wants and she names it plainly: dress the midsummer court and set taste for a year. Ask what she dreads and the answer is Lady Mirelle learning who ordered mourning-black in secret. Then comes the fresh problem—Altered a cloak with orangery perfume still in the lining for Lysa.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; pins patterns while reading faces.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to dress the midsummer court and set taste for a year.
npcs.secret: Quietly arranging matters around this problem: Altered a cloak with orangery perfume still in the lining for Lysa.
npcs.rumor: Customers claim Hedda knows which doors open after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Polite public voice; sharper private asides when trust appears.
npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the mannequin wearing last season's scandalous sleeve.

npcs.name: Orrin Spice
npcs.description: Orrin holds down a spice stall in the market with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Walk into a spice stall in the market and you will find Orrin Spice before you find a free chair. A 55-year-old Halfling spice merchant, Orrin greets trouble the way other folk greet weather: with a coat and a plan. He sneezes into a silk handkerchief with theatrical timing. The locked saffron box that is usually half-full of dyed powder travels with him almost everywhere. Trades with Jor; buys silence from Nedda. His ambition is to secure a caravan monopoly with Jor. His nightmare is customs opening the wrong crate. Right now, Paid Nedda Blacktooth to 'lose' a tariff stamp last month.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; sneezes into a silk handkerchief with theatrical timing.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to secure a caravan monopoly with Jor.
npcs.secret: Quietly arranging matters around this problem: Paid Nedda Blacktooth to 'lose' a tariff stamp last month.

npcs.name: Vela Inkwell
npcs.description: Local bookstore owner whose days orbit a quiet bookstore and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: Some locals swear Vela was born mid-shift at a quiet bookstore; the truth is only slightly less devoted. This elf bookstore owner, now 210, treats competence like courtesy. She shelves by smell of paper as much as subject, never far from the reading ladder with a hidden compartment for banned pamphlets. Seller to Quen; watched by Caldus. Ask what she wants and she names it plainly: preserve a complete run of the old town chronicles. Ask what she dreads and the answer is Brother Caldus demanding a purge of her arcane shelf. Then comes the fresh problem—Magister Quen requested a treatise that shouldn't exist outside a temple vault.
npcs.personality: Dry humor over a careful heart; shelves by smell of paper as much as subject.
npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: preserve a complete run of the old town chronicles.
npcs.secret: Keeps proof related to a problem—Magister Quen requested a treatise that shouldn't exist outside a temple vault.
npcs.rumor: Customers claim Vela knows which doors open after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Storyteller rhythm even when discussing ledgers or latches.
npcs.appearance: Elf features shaped by work at a quiet bookstore; watch for the reading ladder with a hidden compartment for banned pamphlets.

npcs.name: Garr Hopsack
npcs.description: The grain dealer people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: Garr did not plan to become the neighborhood's go-to grain dealer, yet a grain yard made the choice stick. Now 33, the Human measures success in quiet evenings and unpaid favors returned. He kicks sacks to judge dampness, and keeps the wagon chalked with route ciphers the way a confessor keeps secrets. Delivers to Moll Ovenheart and Mira. Hope pulls one way—buy a second wagon before harvest—while caution pulls the other because of blight rumors collapsing prices. One sack in the latest load rattled with coin, not barley.
npcs.personality: Soft-spoken until principles are poked; kicks sacks to judge dampness.
npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to buy a second wagon before harvest.

npcs.name: Issy Needle
npcs.description: Familiar face at a notions shop; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Issy learned the hard corners of settlement life by working them as a haberdasher based out of a notions shop. At 61, the Gnome has a map of loyalties written in calluses rather than ink. Day after day she gifts free buttons to children who bring gossip, and the tin of mother-of-pearl toggles from a wrecked ship marks her place in the room. Gossips with Bea Heartstring. Her north star is to expand into wedding lace. The shadow at her heels is being blamed for a noble's torn gown. Sold black thread in bulk to someone who paid with a temple candle stub.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; gifts free buttons to children who bring gossip.
npcs.motivation: Protect her livelihood long enough to expand into wedding lace.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies the truth: Sold black thread in bulk to someone who paid with a temple candle stub.
npcs.rumor: Issy is said to keep a private list of debts local officials will not touch.
npcs.voice: Measured gnome cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn gnome garb; the tin of mother-of-pearl toggles from a wrecked ship always nearby.

npcs.name: Petra Glass
npcs.description: The apothecary clerk people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: Before dawn, Petra is already at an apothecary shopfront, working as a apothecary clerk with yesterday's work still on her fingers. The habit everyone notices is simple: she labels jars twice, once for customers and once for truth. Close by sits her prized the mortar cracked and wired with silver, a small anchor in a loud settlement. Consults Yara Moss for wild herbs; respects Ora. She wants to earn her own license when the master retires. She fears selling the wrong draft to a pregnant mother more than open confrontation. A useful adventure hook trails her: Someone tried to buy three lethal doses 'for rats' with too much coin.

npcs.name: Quinn Pawn
npcs.description: A pawnbroker rooted at a pawn shop, known for how they never asks names, always asks stories.
npcs.biography: Quinn Pawn's reputation as a pawnbroker was built one careful errand at a time around a pawn shop. Age 41 sits lightly on this Human, except when old debts creak. Watch long enough and you will see that they never asks names, always asks stories. The tray of wedding rings with dates scratched out is part tool, part talisman. Sometimes buys from Silk Mara; tip-toes around Rook. They would trade sleep to stay useful to everyone and owned by no one, yet stays wary of fencing something that brings Serra's investigators. Current spark: Took in a watch badge filed smooth—and logged it under 'costume jewelry'.
